fato_historico: 708: Copper coins are minted in Japan for the first time (Traditional Japanese date: August 10, 708).
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to focus on your value, Taurus. Just as copper coins were once minted to spark flow and prosperity, consider how you can invest in your own foundation today. It is a good time to cultivate resources and enjoy the tangible fruits of your patience while staying grounded in your gentle, stable earth energy.
frase_do_dia: Your value grows when you nurture the seeds you plant with love.
significado_numero: Represents infinite flow, balance, and the manifestation of material prosperity.
conselho: Invest your time in projects that bring you lasting comfort and emotional security.
